g.text: Each class is a JPA entity / table. Association lines are foreign keys. No payment entities.
resolve(admin: UserAccount, outcome: ModerationOutcome, note: String)
• Login blocked until emailVerifiedAt is set (Spring Security isEnabled()).
• Provider: PENDING_APPROVAL after verification. Can log in and edit
profile + availability; cannot submit listings or receive bookings
• bookingEmailsEnabled turns off booking emails only;
account emails (verify, reset) are always sent.
Only the hash is stored. Single-use (consumedAt).
EMAIL_VERIFICATION expires in 24 h, PASSWORD_RESET in 30 min.
Issuing a new token voids unused ones of the same purpose.
pendingEmail: an email change applies only after the link
sent to the new address is opened.
KNOWN requires allergyDetails; other statuses clear it.
Readable only by the customer, or by the provider of that
customer's CONFIRMED appointment. Never logged or audited in full.
Each submission or resubmission creates a new version row;
a submitted version is never edited or deleted.
At most one PENDING version per listing.
Customers see a listing only if: listing ACTIVE, has a
currentApproved version, and provider account ACTIVE.
• Request: slot inside the provider's WeeklyAvailability; booked
version must be the listing's currentApproved.
• Confirm: lock provider row (SELECT … FOR UPDATE), reject if any
• Every status change appends a history row (actor + reason).
Decline requires a reason; "cancelled by" = actor of that row.
• Name/price/duration come from the immutable booked version.
• Notifications are created after commit: in-app always,
email if the recipient has bookingEmailsEnabled.
CHECK: exactly one of review / reply is set.
Review allowed only for a COMPLETED appointment, by its customer;
reply only by that appointment's provider.
One OPEN report per reporter + target.
